remarks: Beautifully remodeled 3 bedroom, 2 full bath Cape Cod in the sought after Smallwood School District, showcasing high end finishes, thoughtful design, and exceptional attention to detail throughout. The home features a 1 car attached garage, central air and a fully fenced yard. Step inside through the striking black and white tiled entryway with a convenient coat closet and into the spacious living room where beautifully refinished hardwood floors and an open staircase create an inviting first impression. The living room flows seamlessly into the dining room which opens to the stunning updated kitchen. Designed with both style and function in mind the kitchen features elegant granite countertops, brand new stainless steel appliances, a generous center island and a walk-in pantry. The kitchen overlooks the family room, creating an open and connected living space while sliding glass doors lead to a stamped concrete patio and beautifully maintained fully fenced yard. Two spacious first floor bedrooms share a beautifully updated full bath featuring a sophisticated double sink vanity and tub/shower combination. A convenient first floor laundry area adds to the home's thoughtful functionality. Upstairs, the private primary suite offers a true retreat, complete with a spacious sitting room and access to a second floor patio. The generously sized primary bedroom features abundant closet space and a beautifully appointed ensuite bath with a custom built-in cambinetry, elegant double-sink vanity and luxurious walk-in shower. The full basement offers additional laundry, storage and features updated mechanicals. From the stylish finishes and beautifully renovated baths to the thoughtfully designed kitchen and inviting indoor-outdoor spaces, this exceptional home blends timeless charm with modern luxury and is truly move-in ready. Updates include but not limited to: HVAC system, ductwork & central air '25, rewired electrical '25, concrete patio '26, 1st and 2nd floor bathroom remodel '25, refinished hardwood floors '26, kitchen remodel '25, insulation '25, 2nd floor windows '25-26, 2nd floor hardwood flooring '25 & more! Square footage based on floor plan.
